scientific_question: Given the complete 27-direction portfolio index and the four occupied ACTIVE/MEDIUM DM chains, what overall cross-direction priority, capacity, lifecycle, dependency and real-resource plan should Portfolio adopt now? The live DM inputs are ACVC's proposed independent-fit B, RCLE's bounded longer-training B, MGTAP's outcome-informed descriptive A/recon, and FOLR's fresh-learning B versus a scientifically supported PARK alternative. Compare those inputs and credible competing options without selecting ordinary A/B objects on the DMs' behalf. Preserve every existing lifecycle, priority, recast, frozen object scope, cumulative cap and contrary result; identify only genuinely Portfolio-tier choices and the facts that would change them.
deliverable: Write one conclusion-first complete Portfolio plan for the entire registered program. State which directions advance, defer, park or remain unchanged; cross-direction priority and capacity treatment; any true resource expansion or dependency decision; whether any fusion/separation or replacement is warranted; the owner and next action for each unresolved Portfolio boundary; and the next material evidence/review trigger. Treat ordinary within-mechanism A/B selection, implementation, admission, launch, collection and technical acceptance as DM standing delegation with no per-experiment Portfolio grant or Root/Clerk ACK gate. Preserve all 27 index rows and distinguish DM recommendations from Pro choices. For ACVC, MGTAP, RCLE and FOLR, retain each recommendation and strongest competing option, but do not convert them into automatic approvals. If a direction-level lifecycle choice is unresolved, give the explicit revisit condition and responsible node. Record actual scope, limits, uncertainty and contrary evidence; no new experiment, code, literature census or result-bearing exposure is authorized by this consultation.
claim_ceiling: Prospective overall Portfolio priority, capacity, lifecycle, dependency and real-resource planning only. No ordinary A/B approval, scientific result reinterpretation, stable superiority claim, causal identification, mechanism proof, exact upper bound, new grant, replacement DM, recast reset, specification change or historical rewrite. Consultation exposure is zero; all evidence is reused published material and live DM proposal facts.
constraints: Adopt AGENTS.md section 2 ordinary direction research belongs to DM: an ended allocation or no-successor answer does not set direction-wide budget to zero; DM declares finite object budgets, cost/resource bounds and stop conditions under standing delegation. Portfolio handles cross-direction priority/capacity, lifecycle, fusion/separation, registration and real resource expansion, not each ordinary experiment.

Use the current main Portfolio, ROOT_HANDOFF and EXPERIMENT_TRACKING records at the pinned commit, retaining the full 27-direction index. Four occupied chains are ACVC, MGTAP, RCLE and FOLR; occupancy is not four advancing runs and finite completion does not release a slot.

ACVC's retained next-use response and current DM input support an independent-fit B option; ordinary object choice remains ACVC DM-owned. MGTAP's post-8231 evidence supports a descriptive outcome-informed A/recon while preserving the old uncertain effect; ordinary A/recon remains MGTAP DM-owned. RCLE's accepted B09 result is complete and its DM proposes a bounded longer-training B alternative; no B10 is presumed funded. FOLR's fixed Generic/BANK use is complete with Generic-only/BANK-worse; its DM supplies a fresh-learning B option versus a scientifically supported PARK alternative, with lifecycle authority kept explicit.

Do not restate 'no remaining allocation' as a blanket prohibition on new ordinary A/B. Do not make Portfolio Pro a launch condition. Preserve frozen object prohibitions, exact caps, uncertain external effects, cleanup inventories and all contrary evidence at their actual scope.

Portfolio may propose a coherent bounded cross-direction program or explicit deferral/revisit condition. Any selected ordinary object is executed by its DM; any real expansion beyond direction-wide cumulative limits must be named as a separate Portfolio choice. No new provider Send or scientific execution occurs in authoring.

Machine exposure for this consultation is zero: no experiments, models, RNG, trajectories, optimization, evaluation, profiling, source implementation or provider Send by the author. Pro reads only the pinned reference files and the scoped Issue snapshot, then writes only the named response file and delivery comment.
